name: Post-drawdown stablecoin-inflow long (1h, ATR-washout gate + volatility exit)
rationale: MECHANISM: same surviving lead effect (inflows arrive AFTER downturns and predict positive returns) but read at 1h with a VOLATILITY-normalised washout gate instead of a raw return floor. A big stablecoin_net_flow_usd inflow while price sits near the low of an elevated-ATR flush marks staggered dip-buying capital arriving on-venue before the bounce. Distinct from variant 04 (4h, ret-based selloff filter): here the selloff is read via atr + range_position, capturing the flush intensity, and the hold is shorter. Other side = forced sellers into the volatility spike. DISCONFIRMER: drop the flow condition and keep only range_position-near-lows + high atr; if that matches net of fees, the flow feature is inert. Kill if the edge needs a per-symbol-tuned ATR window to appear (curve-fit, not a real flush-then-inflow effect).
catalyst: stablecoin inflow near the low of a high-volatility 1h flush
